How It Works

Share the Link

An existing KKA student shares this page with a friend or family member who's keen to try karate.

Book a Free Lesson

The referred friend fills in the form below to book their complimentary first class — no commitment required.

They Sign Up

If your friend loves it and joins Kansai Karate, the reward is automatically unlocked for both of you.

Both Train Free

You get 2 weeks free training. Your friend gets 2 weeks free training. Everyone wins on the mat.
